name: hud_ui_check_toggle_widget_load_from_zrd
description: HudUiCheckToggleWidget::LoadFromZrd delegates base ZRD loading, captures unchecked image state, loads checked/disabled text sections, reuses the root LABEL section for disabled labels, and recomputes local bounds.
known_limits: Binary Ninja marks the reconstruction limited because constructor EH state, reused stack slots, and label/bounds loop structure remain visible; the accepted source matches the observable native behavior and leaves tier S verification to the HudUiCheckToggleWidget source-cluster pass.
Bitmap loading branches depend on the shared zImage::TexDirFindOrCreateByPath provider and are accepted through dependency coverage rather than opening retail texture archives in this focused target.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x4b7340 validates the base HudUiZrdWidget::LoadFromZrd call, checked TEXT creation hidden by default, DISABLE_UNSEL-driven root LABEL insertion into disabledLabelPanels, DISABLE_SEL handling, unchecked image capture, and local bounds recomputation from base label panels.

Native smoke zhud_check_toggle_widget_load_from_zrd_smoke verifies owner origin propagation, checked text panel creation and style application, root LABEL reuse for both base and disabled labels, right-aligned label handling by the local bounds calculation, and disabled label style propagation.
